Appreciate the write-up and the materials — I had a quick read. A few clarifications from our side:

- For the pilot, our compliance team will accept Dedicated only if we can confirm:
  * Customer-managed KMS (we need envelope encryption where the KEK is in our KMS)

Andrew —

Thanks — that checklist is super-helpful. Short answers up front:

- KMS: We support customer-managed KMS for both Dedicated (when keys are in your cloud KMS and we use envelope encryption) and Private (full customer key ownership). For Dedicated we can integrate with AWS KMS / GCP KMS / Azure Key Vault via a customer-managed key policy.

- Tenant separation: Dedicated provides isolated GPU pools and tenancy-level access controls; workloads are logically isolated to your tenant and not co-scheduled with other customers on the same instance pool. We also provide audit logs for inference and admin activity.

- Logs retention & audit: We can export detailed request logs and admin audit logs to your cloud storage (S3/GCS/Azure) with retention policies; default retention is 90 days but can be configured to 1 year per contract.

- Network: Dedicated supports VPC peering and restricted egress to Redwood endpoints. Private VPC gives you a private data plane and option for air-gapped on-prem, which removes outbound egress concerns entirely.

I’m attaching SOC2 Type II and our security pack (SOC2-Type2-Report.pdf included) for the security team to review.

Next steps:
- Ben, can you run through the checklist on a quick call (30 min) and confirm which items are Covered / Requires contract / Requires Private?
- Andrew, if you can share a single prioritized list (top 5 must-haves), we'll map them to Dedicated vs Private and return a recommendation by EOD Thursday.

Thanks,
Marissa

Attachments: SOC2-Type2-Report.pdf; Redwood_Security_Pack_v2.pdf

Hi Andrew / Marissa —

Happy to join. Quick technical notes ahead of the call so we can be efficient:

- KMS integration: For Dedicated we use envelope encryption. We hold the data-plane process, but the KEK never leaves your KMS; we support customer-supplied keys and rotate them per your policy. For Private (VPC / on-prem) you retain full key control on-prem/HSM.

- Tenant isolation: Dedicated provides dedicated worker pools per customer — logical multi-tenant control plane, single-tenant data plane for inference workloads. If you require physical host isolation we can scope that into Dedicated Reserved Nodes (extra cost) or recommend Private.

- Audit & logging: We can stream audit logs (inference request metadata, admin actions, model loads) to your S3/GCS with signed delivery and retention rules. For Dedicated we can guarantee 1y retention via contract addendum.

- Network options: VPC peering and private link are supported. If your infra team requires no outbound egress, Private VPC or on-prem is the path forward.

Proposed checklist for our call (30 min):
1) Confirm KMS provider and whether a HSM is required
2) Confirm whether physical host isolation is required
3) Confirm required log retention and destination
4) Confirm network topology preference (peering vs private link vs on-prem)
5) Timeline for pilot & decision point

I’m available today 10:30–11:30 PT or 16:00–17:00 PT. Marissa — I’ll join the slot you pick and prepare a short mapping doc (Covered / Contract addendum / Private required).

Thanks,
